toolsPreview.name: get_parcel_quote
toolsPreview.description: Price one US-domestic parcel across USPS, UPS and FedEx. Describe the item in plain words and the packed box size and weight are estimated; give exact dimensions and weight to skip the estimate. Returns up to five purchasable services with the checkout total, the carrier cost beneath it and the SMKlog fee stated separately. Oversized, palletized or crated shipments come back routed to a human review instead of a price. Labels are bought on smklog.com, not through this tool.

toolsPreview.name: create_checkout_link
toolsPreview.description: Prices the shipment live and returns a payment session: the amount, and a handoff URL that opens the SMKlog checkout prefilled with this shipment. The human confirms the contents certification and the carrier-adjustment consent there and pays on Stripe hosted checkout. This tool never charges anything itself — MPP intent "session", not "charge".
